title: Measure GTK2 GtkEntry selection and line metrics against native VUE

reference.source: R113 idle samples and existing paired GTK2 runtime captures

gtk2_candidate_font.scope: Temporary RC override for measurement only; not installed or committed as the product font.

adjacent_sizes.9_pt: Pango logical height 15 px; rendered selection 7x15 px.
adjacent_sizes.9_5_pt: Pango logical height 17 px; rendered selection 7x17 px.

findings: The R115 44 px artificial allocation overstated the caret height; repeating at the measured 34 px VUE field height reduced that confound.
With the runtime's inherited Nimbus Sans 12 font, the measured Pango line and selected field are 23 px tall, seven pixels taller than the native 16 px cell.

A temporary DejaVu Sans Mono 9.25 candidate reproduces the 8 px character advance and 16 px Pango line, but GTK2 paints a 7 px-wide selected region. The candidate family is not proven to match the VUE font.
Changing GtkEntry inner-border shifted the selection but did not change its 23 px height, so padding alone is not a line-metric correction.
limits: This is a native-pixel measurement and a GTK2 Xvfb runtime experiment, not human approval.
The exact font resource used by this VUE File Finder field remains unidentified.
No GTK2 theme, user profile, open XChat, MAME setting, or guest file was changed.
KWin palette-change integration and application reload remain untested. The shared MAME channel was not used because its permissions fail the live-control helper's safety check.
next: Resolve the one-pixel selection-width difference and identify a justified font policy for the GTK2 adapter; then finish authorized palette integration/reload and session validation.
